description: This file implements the monitor_rssi class, which manages RSSI monitoring, ARP requests/replies, and idle station detection within a network management context. It handles socket creation, ARP packet processing, and sends notifications based on RSSI changes and station activity status.

classes.name: monitor_rssi
classes.description: Class responsible for monitoring RSSI, handling ARP requests/replies, and detecting idle stations in a network.

methods.name: monitor_rssi
methods.description: Constructor initializing the monitor_rssi object with a message transmission reference.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops monitoring, closes sockets, and resets internal state.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes monitoring by creating sockets and setting up internal references.

methods.name: get_arp_socket
methods.description: Returns the current ARP socket class object.

methods.name: arp_recv
methods.description: Processes incoming ARP packets, updates station states, and sends notifications.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main periodic function to handle station state transitions, send ARP requests, and generate RSSI notifications.

methods.name: send_rssi_measurement_response
methods.description: Sends RSSI measurement response messages to stations that requested them.

methods.name: monitor_idle_station
methods.description: Detects idle stations based on byte thresholds and sends no-activity notifications.
